[[Hodat the Tumbler]] is an [[elemental]] [[warrior]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Dalada Uplands]] if the party has completed the [[Forgotten Relics]] [[quest]].

== Locations == 
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** {{NPC location|Dalada Uplands}} (only spawns after the completion of [[Forgotten Relics]])

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Backbreaker}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Belly Smash}}
* {{Skill icon|Crude Swing}}
* {{Skill icon|Distracting Blow}}
* {{Skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{Skill icon|Mokele Smash}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Hodat's Maul]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* The [[Flaming Scepter Mage]]s replace Hodat and the accompanying group of [[Stone Fury|Stone Furies]] before completion of [[Forgotten Relics]].
